questions.prompt: With withInterceptors([a, b]), put the steps of one request and its response in order.
questions.explanation: Requests flow through the array in order, and responses flow back in reverse.

questions.prompt: How should an interceptor add an Authorization header?

options.text: Store the header in localStorage so the browser sends it

questions.explanation: HttpRequest is immutable. headers.set() returns a new HttpHeaders object without changing the request, so you must clone the request.

questions.prompt: Two requests run in parallel. A loading interceptor sets a boolean to true on start and false in finalize. What goes wrong?

options.text: Nothing; finalize waits for all requests
The loader hides when the first request finishes, while the second is still running

questions.explanation: Each request finishes independently. Count pending requests and show the loader while the count is above zero.

questions.prompt: Which class creates a typed key for per-request options that interceptors read with req.context.get()?
questions.explanation: new HttpContextToken<boolean>(() => false) defines an option with a default. Callers set it with new HttpContext().set(TOKEN, true).

questions.prompt: Which are good rules for a retry interceptor? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Retry GET requests on network errors (status 0) or 5xx responses
Retry every POST up to three times
Give up immediately on 4xx errors like 400 or 404
Wait a little longer before each new attempt

questions.explanation: Retry only idempotent requests and only transient failures, with backoff. Retrying POST can create duplicates, and 4xx errors won't fix themselves.

questions.prompt: Why should an auth interceptor check the request's host before attaching the token?

options.text: Angular rejects headers on absolute URLs
To avoid leaking the user's token to third-party APIs and CDNs
Because tokens only work on GET requests

questions.explanation: Interceptors see every HttpClient call, including ones to other hosts. Only your own API should receive the token.
